description: Search for a username across social networks and websites. Returns a dict of site names to {status, url, tags}. Status values: CLAIMED (found), NOT_FOUND, ERROR. Params: username (str, required) — the username to search; top_sites (int, default 500) — how many sites to check; tags (str, optional) — comma-separated filter tags e.g. 'social,photo'; timeout (int, default 30) — seconds per request.

tags.description: Comma-separated category filter, e.g. 'social,photo,gaming'. Use list_available_tags to see options.

description: Search for a username and return ONLY confirmed accounts (CLAIMED status). Returns a list of {site, url, tags}. Best tool when you just want to know where someone has accounts. Params: username (str, required); top_sites (int, default 500); tags (str, optional) — comma-separated e.g. 'social,gaming'; timeout (int, default 30).

List all available site category tags that can be used to filter username searches. Returns a sorted list of tag strings such as 'social', 'gaming', 'photo', 'music', 'dating'. No parameters required.

Fetch the transcript of a YouTube video as a list of timestamped snippets. Returns list of {text, start, duration}. Params: video (str, required) — video ID e.g. 'dQw4w9WgXcQ' OR full YouTube URL; languages (str, default 'en') — comma-separated language priority list e.g. 'en' or 'zh,en' (tries first language, falls back to next).

video.description: Video ID (e.g. 'dQw4w9WgXcQ') or full YouTube URL

languages.description: Comma-separated language priority list e.g. 'en' or 'zh,en'

description: Fetch the full transcript of a YouTube video as a single plain text string. Best for summarizing, translating, or analyzing video content. Params: video (str, required) — video ID e.g. 'dQw4w9WgXcQ' OR full YouTube URL; languages (str, default 'en') — comma-separated language priority list e.g. 'en' or 'zh,en'.

video.description: Video ID (e.g. 'dQw4w9WgXcQ') or full YouTube URL

languages.description: Comma-separated language priority list e.g. 'en' or 'zh,en'

description: List all available transcript languages for a YouTube video. Returns list of {language, language_code, is_generated, is_translatable}. Use this before get_transcript when the default 'en' language fails. Params: video (str, required) — video ID or full YouTube URL.

video.description: Video ID (e.g. 'dQw4w9WgXcQ') or full YouTube URL

description: Render a Mermaid diagram to a PNG or SVG image file using the mermaid.ink API — no local installation required. Params: diagram (str, required) — Mermaid diagram source code e.g. 'flowchart TD\n A --> B'; output_path (str, required) — absolute path to save the file e.g. '/path/to/flow.png'; fmt (str, default 'png') — 'png' or 'svg'. Returns saved file path or error message.

output_path.description: Absolute path to save the output file

description: Get the mermaid.ink URL for a Mermaid diagram without downloading it. Useful for embedding diagrams in Markdown as image URLs. Params: diagram (str, required) — Mermaid diagram source code; fmt (str, default 'png') — 'png' or 'svg'. Returns the full mermaid.ink URL.

Fetch top news headlines from Google News. Returns a JSON list of articles each with: title, url, published_date, publisher, description. Params: country (str, default 'US') — 2-letter country code; language (str, default 'en'); period (str, default '1d') — '1h','1d','7d','30d'; max_results (int, default 10).

Search news articles by keyword using Google News. Returns a JSON list with: title, url, published_date, publisher, description. Params: query (str, required) — keywords e.g. 'AI regulation'; language (str, default 'en'); country (str, default 'US'); period (str, default '7d'); max_results (int, default 10).
Fetch and parse a full news article from a URL. Returns JSON with: title, text (full body up to 3000 chars), authors, publish_date, top_image, url. Params: url (str, required) — full article URL.

Get the current stock price and key metrics for a single ticker. Returns JSON with: symbol, name, price, change, change_pct, open, volume, market_cap, day_high, day_low, week_52_high, week_52_low, pe_ratio, currency. Params: symbol (str, required) — ticker e.g. 'AAPL', 'TSLA', 'LMT'.

Get current prices for multiple stocks at once. Returns a JSON list of stock objects each with: symbol, name, price, change, change_pct, open, volume, market_cap, day_high, day_low, week_52_high, week_52_low, pe_ratio, currency. Params: symbols (str, required) — comma-separated tickers e.g. 'AAPL,MSFT,TSLA'.

Get historical OHLCV price data for a stock. Returns JSON with arrays: dates, open, high, low, close, volume. Params: symbol (str, required) — ticker e.g. 'AAPL'; period (str, default '1mo') — '1d','5d','1mo','3mo','6mo','1y','2y','5y'.

Check which websites an email address is registered on using holehe. Queries 120+ sites (social, gaming, music, mail, etc.) via password-recovery probing. Returns a list of dicts with keys: name, domain, exists (bool), rateLimit (bool), emailrecovery, phoneNumber, others. Use check_email_claimed_only to get only confirmed hits. Params: email (str, required) — target email address to search; timeout (int, default 10) — per-request timeout in seconds.

email.description: Target email address to search across 120+ websites

description: Check which websites an email address is registered on and return ONLY confirmed hits (exists=True). Skips rate-limited or errored sites. Returns a list of dicts with keys: name, domain, emailrecovery, phoneNumber, others. Best when you just want to know where an email has accounts. Params: email (str, required) — target email address to search; timeout (int, default 10) — per-request timeout in seconds.

email.description: Target email address to search across 120+ websites

description: Download a video from YouTube or any yt-dlp supported site to a local directory. Downloads a pre-merged mp4 — no ffmpeg required. For highest quality pass format='bestvideo+bestaudio/best' (requires ffmpeg). Params: url (str, required) — full video URL e.g. 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xxx'; output_dir (str, default 'output') — directory path to save the file; format (str, default 'best[ext=mp4]/best') — yt-dlp format selector string. Returns the downloaded file path on success or an error message string.

output_dir.description: Directory path to save the downloaded file

description: Fetch metadata for a video without downloading it. Works with YouTube and thousands of other sites supported by yt-dlp. Params: url (str, required) — full video URL. Returns JSON string with title, duration (seconds), uploader, view_count, upload_date, webpage_url, formats_count.

Download only the audio track from a video as an m4a file. Works with YouTube and thousands of other sites. Params: url (str, required) — full video URL; output_dir (str, default 'output') — directory path to save the file. Returns the audio file path on success or an error message string. Requires ffmpeg installed on the system.

output_dir.description: Directory path to save the audio file
